newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun mulls redevelopment of Furama.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun mulls redevelopment of Furama.

text.p: Lai Sun Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday it was considering redeveloping the Furama Hotel and Ritz-Carlton hotel into a commercial complex but no concrete plans had yet been finalised.
"The group is considering various redevelopment opportunities including a redevelopment of the two sites together," a Lai Sun group spokeswoman said.
The Furama hotel stands next to the Ritz-Carlton hotel in Hong Kong's prime office district of Central.
"No concrete plans can be made until the completion of our recent purchase of a stake in Furama," the spokeswoman said.
"It can be a hotel development, a commmercial complex or something else."

Lai Sun Development said last week it had agreed to buy a 45.42 percent controlling stake in Furama Hotel Enterprises Ltd for HK$3.13 billion and would make a general cash offer for the remaining shares at HK$33.50 each.
Lai Sun Development owns about 52.83 percent of Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd which controls the Ritz-Carlton.
